{{Intro/Quest|Echoing Marche}}

==Steps==
#Rest until the morning (7:00 - 10:00)
#Meet Chixia at Panhua's Restaurant
#Head to the city gate
##Arrive at the gate
#Get ready to leave the city
##Arrive at the gate
##(Optional) Learn about the Simulation: Resonance Potion
#Arrive at city gate
#Go to the Rearguards Base
#Ask the soldiers about Zhiyuan
#Use Sensor to confirm the patrol route
#Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon
#Defeat the Exiles
#Repair the Detection Beacon
#Check the other Detection Beacon
#Use Levitator to burn off the thorns with Explosive Charge
#Repair the Detection Beacon
#Arrive at the Rearguards Base
#Ask the staffs about the current situation
#Look after the wounded soldiers in the Rearguards Base(0/2)
#Talk to the medics
#Take the elevator to reach the upper level
#Reach the upper level
#Ask the quartermaster about the situation
#Ask Jianxin about how it went for her
#Discuss your plans with Yangyang
#Stand your ground. Defeat all Tacet Discords

==Gameplay Notes==
* Completing the "Ask the quartermaster about the situation" step will award the player {{Item|Mangosteen}}.
* Completing the quest will award the player {{Item|Leaf affected by "Waveworn"}} and the ''[[Rover's Journey]]'' [[trophy]] ''[[Thus Spoke the Magistrate: Frontline Calls]]'.

==Dialogue ==
{{Quest Description|As the tides of danger retreat, Jinzhou appears tranquil and vibrant. But beyond its borders lies a fierce and desperate battleground.}}
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(Meet Chixia at Panhua's Restaurant)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_132_1.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Mrs. [[Panhua]], g'morning! Three bowls of extra spicy noodles, please!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_1.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' What did I tell ya? Nothing beats a bowl of spicy noodles in the morning!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_2.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' What do you say, [[Rover]]?
:{{DIcon}} I haven't had my first bite yet.
:{{DIcon}} It's way too spicy.
:{{DIcon}} I love it. It's just the way I like!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_6.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Looks like [[Baizhi]]'s locked herself in the lab again, hasn't left since yesterday. Bet we won't see her til she's done with her research.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_7.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' No, wait. Since you're the subject of that research, we could use you as bait to lure her out. We can tie you up at the [[Huaxu Academy|Academy]]'s entrance ...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_8.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' And with just a few tugs of the rope, I bet every researcher will come running at you, with Baizhi leading the pack. Hook, line, and sinker!
:{{DIcon}} We could give it a try.
::'''Chixia:''' In case of an emergency! Rover, roll out! 
:{{DIcon}} Hahaha.
:{{DIcon}} That sounds dangerous.
::'''Chixia:''' Oops. I got carried away. My bad!
:{{DIcon}} Let's not try that.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_15.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' By the way. Now that we've figured out the sugar pearl and the sundial, all that's left is that weird leaf and run-of-the-mill mangosteen, right?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_16.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' So it only took us one trip to the Academy to solve half of our problems. Either Rover's really smart, or [[Jinhsi|Madam Magistrate]] was gonna make it easy for us to begin with.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_17.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' What's our next plan of action, Rover?
:{{DIcon}} Look into the mangosteen first.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_22.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' As for the mangosteen, we've got people selling these at the market nearby. Might find some clues there.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_23.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Mangosteens are not from [[Jinzhou]]. These fruits are usually brought in by boat. Should we start from the harbor?
::{{DIcon}} Let's leave the city.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_27.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Do you think the token is guiding us outside the city?
:{{DIcon}} Look into the strange leaf first.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_28.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Baizhi said the leaf bears the frequencies of [[Tacet Discord]]s, so it must be from a tree near a [[Tacet Field]].
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_29.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Then we must leave the city to pursue this lead.
:{{DIcon}} We've got two more days. Might as well just wait.
::'''Yangyang:''' Yes, that may work too. Any plans for the next two days, Rover?
:{{DIcon}} I have other plans.
:{{DIcon|Option}} (Tell them about the dream you had.)
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_34.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' An ocean of stars ... A [[Mysterious Woman|dark-haired girl]] ... An inverted [[Etheric Sea]] ... And the Resonance Chord flowing from your [[Tacet Mark]] ..
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_35.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' And you said it was flowing in a certain direction. The nearest places are the [[Gorges of Spirits]] and the [[Norfall Barrens]] ...
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_36.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' You've never mentioned this before.
::{{DIcon}} I couldn't find the right moment.
::{{DIcon}} I thought it was just a dream.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_39.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' The Etheric Sea and Resonance Chords in your dreams are real, possibly leading to the Gorges of Spirits and Norfall Barrens.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_40.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Perhaps ... It was more than just a dream.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_41.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' That girl might be the key to recovering your memories. Madam Magistrate's information aside, it seems to me your dream points toward the Norfall Barrens.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_42.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It's the site of the Threnodian War and the source of all TD Outbreaks. The [[Midnight Rangers]]' frontlines base is stationed there as well.
:{{DIcon}} Madam Magistrate gave me the Access Pass for that.
::'''Yangyang:''' The Access Pass may be another hint...
::'''Yangyang:''' There are usually no checkpoints set up in the city besides the [[City Hall]]. A pass isn't required unless you have to leave the city borders.
::'''Chixia:''' Now why didn't I think of that? Gotta hand it to ya, Yangyang!
:{{DIcon}} My body aches for battle!
::'''Chixia:''' That's the spirit! Been beating my brain up until now, it's time to get these joints cracking for a change!
:::{{DIcon}} I don't know who I am.
::::{{DIcon}} I don't know why I'm here.
:::::{{DIcon}} All I know is I must kill!
::'''Chixia:''' Whoooah! He's fast! He's furious! He's a TD killing machine!
::'''Yangyang:''' ...Please stop it, you two.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_52.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' It's a no-go for me if you're leaving the city, my shift's coming up. Protect Rover well and shoot me a message if you need anything, alright Yangyang?
:{{DIcon}} I'm sure you meant the other way around.
:{{DIcon}} I'm really strong, you know.
:{{DIcon}} You can just wait for the good news.
:{{DIcon}} Yangyang is safe with me.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_57.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' I believe in ya!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2_48_58.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Without a doubt.
;New Function Unlocked, [[Event]]s. Participate in various activities on the land of Solaris to earn rewards.)
----
;(Arrive at the gate)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_yindao_7_1.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' We Resonators can boost our combat abilities with special items. Our Echoes can use them too.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_yindao_7_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' If you feel like it, head to Instructor [[Yhan]] at the training camp for extra practice and to get these enhancement items.
----
;(Get ready to leave the city)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_yindao_6_1.ogg}} '''Chixia:''' Yangyang, did you hear that? I-Is that someone crying and wailing?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_yindao_6_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' That should be the Midnight Rangers training camp... Let's not worry about it, Chixia.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_yindao_6_3_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo hlmq 1_yindao_6_3_F.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Instructor Yhan is in charge of training new recruits. I heard he's pretty tough, but I think Rover can handle anything he throws at him/her.
----
;(Arrive at the gate)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_1_1.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Defense at the city gate has been strengthened.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_1_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' It wasn't like this when we came back...
----
;(Arrive at city gate)
;Huanglong 1 Act 1 Echoing Marche [Unlocked]
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_1.ogg}} '''Guarding Soldier:''' Access Pass is required if you're heading to the Norfall Barrens. That place is now off-limits.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_2.ogg}} '''Shifting Soldier:''' ...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_3.ogg}} '''Shifting Soldier:''' What is your business, young lady? It's my third shift and you're still here.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_4.ogg}} '''??:''' Oh, you must be the soldier on duty at noon yesterday. Nice to see you again.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_5.ogg}} '''??:''' I'm a Resonator and a trained martial artist. I can handle myself. Please, I need to go look for someone.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_6.ogg}} '''??:''' I've promised the missing man's grandfather to bring him back. Would you let me through?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_7.ogg}} '''Guarding Soldier:''' Be that as it may, I cannot let you given the current circumstances. My apologies.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_8.ogg}} '''??:''' Well, everything seems fine in the city. Are things really that bad on the frontlines?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_9.ogg}} '''Shifting Soldier:''' That's why we must stay vigilant, so people in the city can go on peacefully with their lives.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_10.ogg}} '''Guarding Soldier:''' Besides, General [[Jiyan]] is currently there at the Norfall Barrens base. Dangerous as it is, he will keep an eye on every soldier, including the one you're looking for.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_11.ogg}} '''Shifting Soldier:''' We have already sent a report on your case. You could just go home and wait for the good news. What's the point of staying here?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_12.ogg}} '''??:''' Thank you, but I have already asked the Patrol Station for help and tried every method I could think of. Please, let me through. I promised him, so I gotta give it my all.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_6_6_7.ogg}} '''??:''' I understand your concern.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_14.ogg}} '''??:''' I don't want to be a bother. Would it help if I hid my presence and stayed somewhere further away? How about five miles? Or maybe a hundred? A thousand might be too far though, I wouldn't be able to see you clearly...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_15.ogg}} '''Shifting Soldier:''' Listen. Nobody knows when the soldiers will return, and even if they do, you might not find the one you seek.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_16.ogg}} '''Shifting Soldier:''' It's a dangerous road ahead if you want to reach the frontlines, and you don't even have an Access Pass...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_19.ogg}} '''Shifting Soldier:''' ...Ahem. Your Access Pass has been verified.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_20.ogg}} '''Guarding Soldier:''' Just you two?
:{{DIcon|Option}} Yes
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_23.ogg}} '''??:''' Greetings. I'm [[Jianxin]]. Could you please do me a favor?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_24.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' I want to go look for someone outside the city, but I don't have an Access Pass, so... May I tag along?
::{{DIcon}} Okay.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_29.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Thank you for your kindness!
::{{DIcon}} What can you do for us?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_30.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' I'm a jack-of-all-trades: Tai Chi, cooking, tea-making, mining, foraging, errand-running, fixing utilities, and caring for animals. Got something else in mind? I'm always up for learning new skills.
:::{{DIcon}} Alright then.
::{{DIcon}} What do I get out of this?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_32.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' I see. I've got three Guokui Flatbreads, 34 Shell Credits, and the Mirrors of Clarity. They're all yours.
:::{{DIcon}} You seem to live a humble life.
:::{{DIcon}} You can keep them.
::{{DIcon}} You'll have to ask the guards about that.
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_35.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' You're right. I should be open about my request. I don't want to lie and cause further trouble for the soldiers.
:{{DIcon}} The monk over there is coming with us.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_46.ogg}} '''??:''' Thank you for your help! I really appreciate it!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_36.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' I intend to leave the city with them, and they have agreed. Will it be an issue for you?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_37.ogg}} '''Shifting Soldier:''' I, uh...
:{{DIcon}} Is it allowed?
:{{DIcon}} Please.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_40.ogg}} '''Guarding Soldier:''' Well, it says you have the highest level of access, so no procedural issues here.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_41_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_41_F.ogg}} '''Shifting Soldier:''' (Honestly, he/she could lead an entire troop out of the city with that Access Pass and no one would question it...)
:{{DIcon}} Let's go.
:{{DIcon}} Master Jianxin?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_2_44.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Sure!
:'''Jianxin explained why she wanted to leave the city. She told you about the person she is looking for.
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' So you're looking for the relative of a veteran, and you believe he's in the Midnight Rangers camp in Desorock Highland?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_3.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Exactly.
:{{DIcon}} What's your relationship with the person you're looking for?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_9.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' His name is Zhiyuan. I don't know him in person. On my way down the mountain, I ran into his grandfather, who was looking for his grandson on his own but ended up lost.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_10.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' I couldn't just leave an elderly person like him out there. So I thought I'd escort him to the nearest city and make further plans once we're safe.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_11.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' You're willing to go to such lengths for someone you don't know...
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_12.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' You have a kind soul, Master Jianxin.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_13.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' It's all thanks to many kind-hearted people. Without them, Mr. Zongye and I wouldn't have made it to Jinzhou.
:{{DIcon}} Why is it so important for you to find him?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_14.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Mr. Zongye seemed confused. He's gone through a lot searching for his enlisted grandson. Lending a helping hand was the least I could do.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_15.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' I reported his situation to the Patrol Station, but with the chaos on the frontline, Mr. Zongye has been extremely worried about his grandson's safety... He'd sneak out to look for his grandson the moment no one was watching.
:{{DIcon}} Do you know anything about the mangosteen?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_16.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' This mangosteen?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_17.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' It's got some fresh-looking leaves, soft springy skin, and eight fleshy segments fully ripened inside. It looks like a nice fruit.
::{{DIcon}} Good to know.
::{{DIcon}} Well... thanks for the tip on how to pick out the good ones.
::{{DIcon}} How do you know that?
:::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_22.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Oh, one more thing I forgot to mention. There's a bruise at the bottom. If you don't eat that part soon, it'll spoil.
::{{DIcon}} Nothing else?
:{{DIcon}} Where are you from?
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_23.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' I grew up in my sect on a mountain. Spent most of my time training with my masters.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_24.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' One day, I was told training in seclusion was not enough. I must engage with the world to further my skills.
::{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_25.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' So I started my self-cultivating journey. I've been to various cities and gained valuable lessons, but there is still so much more to learn.
:{{DIcon|Arrow}} Got it.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_26.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' ...According to what I've gathered, Mr. Zongye's grandson is very likely in the Desorock Highland.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_27.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Thanks to your help, I can finally leave the city to find him.
:{{DIcon}} That's where we are heading too.
:{{DIcon}} Let's go together.
:{{DIcon}} Master Jianxin, please keep us safe.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_3_31.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Of course.
----
;(Ask the soldiers about Zhiyuan)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_1.ogg}} '''Passing Midnight Ranger:''' You don't look like soldiers. Why are you here? The frontlines are right up ahead.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' I am Yangyang, an Outrider of the Midnight Rangers.
:'''Yangyang showed her Midnight Rangers badge and Jianxin asked him about Zhiyuan.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_4.ogg}} '''Passing Midnight Ranger:''' A missing person... Zhiyuan...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_5.ogg}} '''Passing Midnight Ranger:''' The one you're looking for. Is he an average person? Not a Resonator, I suppose?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_6.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Yes, have you seen him? Is he alright?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_7.ogg}} '''Passing Midnight Ranger:''' I met him once. He's not officially enlisted, but he seemed determined to join us. He's been secretly following our troops since last year.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_17.ogg}} '''Passing Midnight Ranger:''' I think a quartermaster of the Rearguards escorted him away, so if he's not in the city ...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_8.ogg}} '''Passing Midnight Ranger:''' He must be in the Rearguards camp. He can't be anywhere else; the actual frontlines are right up ahead, and we the Midnight Rangers would never allow non-servicemen to approach and risk getting killed.
:{{DIcon}} I see.
:{{DIcon}} Master Jianxin.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_11.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Thank you!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_13.ogg}} '''Passing Midnight Ranger:''' Now if you're heading that way, I have a request for you, my Outrider comrade.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_14.ogg}} '''Passing Midnight Ranger:''' On your way there, you should run into two Detection Beacons. They just went offline. Could you go check on them?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_15.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Sure, we will.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_4_16.ogg}} '''Passing Midnight Ranger:''' Great. I'll send the coordinates to your Terminal.
----
;(Follow the patrol route to find the Detection Beacon)
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_41_1.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Is that the Beacon? Why are there so many people?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_41_2.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' They don't look like soldiers...
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_42_1.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Greetings. What might interest you here? It's dangerous.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_42_2.ogg}} '''Strange Civilian?:''' Oh. We, uh... Nothing, really. You see, we're just on our way south, to the city.
:{{DIcon}} Stop lying. I saw it.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_42_4.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Excuse me, about this Detection Beacon...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_42_5.ogg}} '''Strange Civilian?:''' Run, everyone!
:{{DIcon}} Something's fishy about them.
:{{DIcon}} Don't let them run off.
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_1.ogg}} '''Timid Civilian?:''' I-I can't move... So hungry...
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_2.ogg}} '''Flustered Civilian?:''' P-Please don't arrest us! We really had no choice!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_3.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' What happened? Do you need help?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_4.ogg}} '''Timid Civilian?:''' The battles are getting real bad up north, and we couldn't live there anymore. Figured we have to go back to the city.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_5.ogg}} '''Timid Civilian?:''' We ain't eaten in ages, and we're broke. Some of us can barely move 'cause we're so damn hungry.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_6.ogg}} '''Timid Civilian?:''' Then we found some expensive looking stuff here. Now that the military's out there fighting and nobody's really using these thingies, we thought it might get us a few pennies.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_7.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' A damaged Detection Beacon might result in a sudden TD invasion from the direction it covers.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_8.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' Our frontline troops would face attacks from both sides. Have you thought about the consequences?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_9.ogg}} '''Flustered Civilian?:''' We ain't got the time for that! If we don't steal, we'd starve to death before the Tacet Discords kill us.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_10.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' You shouldn't be stealing public property. Please return the parts.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_11.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' There's still some distance from here to Jinzhou city. Here, you can have my flatbreads.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_12.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' And here's some money. This should be enough for you to reach the city.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_13.ogg}} '''Timid Civilian?:''' You're giving us ... all of these? Thank you. Thank you!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_14.ogg}} '''Flustered Civilian?:''' Hey! You! Come over and say thank you before you eat!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_15.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' It was nothing. Master once told me, "The sage takes care of all men,and abandons none."
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_16_M.ogg}} {{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_43_16_F.ogg}} '''Rover:''' Watch out!
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_400_1.ogg}} '''Strange Civilian?:''' Hmph, a tough nut, aren't you?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_400_2.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' I just helped you. Why did you attack us?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_400_3.ogg}} '''Strange Civilian?:''' You're not feedin' all of us with ya bread and pennies. Hand over your goods and grub or face the consequences.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_400_4.ogg}} '''Strange Civilian?:''' We ain't messin' with no kids, but don't test our patience. Just do as you're told!
----
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_44_1.ogg}} '''Flustered Civilian?:''' We're beggin' ya, stop! We surrender. Take us in!
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_44_2.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Why did you attack us when I already gave you food and funds?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_44_3.ogg}} '''Jianxin:''' Do you have other mouths to feed, aside from what we see here?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_44_8.ogg}} '''Yangyang:''' They seem trained... These are not ordinary people.
:{{DIcon}} Who are you?
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_44_10.ogg}} '''Elder Exile:''' O-of course we are ordinary people! We just ... we just joined the Exiles recently.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_44_11.ogg}} '''Elder Exile:''' We done some wrongs. Tried to run from them Patrollers and left the city, but dang, didn't know the battles up north were so crazy. Our new boss ran outta food before we could even figure out the camp. Figured we'd be better off just to go back to the city and get worked up.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_44_12.ogg}} '''Timid Exile:''' Then we ran outta food and cash halfway. So we turned to thieving.
:{{A|Vo hlmq 1_2EX_44_13.ogg}} '''Timid Exile:''' We ain't got the balls to rob the army, but with stuff just sitting around, why not?
